items.title: Provider runner: gemini-cli.ts -> antigravity-cli.ts (binary agy, drop usage extraction)
items.context: Rename packages/main/src/providers/gemini-cli.ts to antigravity-cli.ts: GEMINI_CLI_BINARY='gemini' -> ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_BINARY='agy'; geminiCliAvailable -> antigravityCliAvailable; runBoundedGeminiProvider -> runBoundedAntigravityProvider (ProviderExecResult.provider='antigravity'). REMOVE extractGeminiUsage/isGeminiUsageObject (agy does not emit usageMetadata) so reportedUsage is never set. Keep stdout/stderr as digest+byte-count only (raw-never-surfaced). Model: best-effort parse the agy --log-file `label="..."` line, else fall back to the requested --model or 'unknown'. Update the dedicated smoke (provider-gemini-smoke.ts -> provider-antigravity-smoke.ts) to probe `agy` availability + bounded spawn capture.

ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_BINARY constant equals agy; running antigravityCliAvailable with agy in PATH returns true -> confirms binary name change; WHY: binary identity is the atomic rename target

runBoundedAntigravityProvider returns ProviderExecResult with provider=antigravity and reportedUsage is undefined/absent (never set) -> confirms usage extraction was removed and provider name is correct; WHY: agy does not emit usageMetadata so extraction must not exist

stdout/stderr in ProviderExecResult contain only digest (sha256) + byteCount fields, never raw content -> confirms raw-never-surfaced invariant; WHY: security invariant that raw LLM output is never persisted in result struct
model field is parsed from agy --log-file label= line when present, falls back to requested --model or unknown -> confirms best-effort model extraction; WHY: model attribution for ledger records

items.title: Reconcile dispatch-policy host model (antigravity pre-exists) + retire legacy gemini refusal/availability smokes
items.context: antigravity ALREADY exists as a scaffolded/refused host; gemini is the legacy real-leaf host. This is a PROMOTE+RETIRE, not a blind rename — do NOT sed gemini->antigravity blindly (it would create antigravity||antigravity duplicates). Specifically: dispatch-policy.ts — remove "gemini" from LEGACY_KNOWN_HOSTS and from parseHost (~line 99); in the unsupportedRealHosts filters (~lines 256/406) antigravity is ALREADY listed, so just drop the "gemini" term (no duplicate). lattice-dispatch.ts ~lines 815/2654 comments ("codex/legacy gemini real-host live dispatch exists; antigravity is scaffolded") — update so antigravity carries the real-leaf agy path. Rationale text in process-fact-levels.ts:215 and command-policy.ts:274 ("Gemini is legacy compatibility only" / "Antigravity remain scaffolded/refused real-subprocess targets") — update: antigravity gains the supervised real-leaf path (binary agy) but STAYS refused for unattended dispatch_auto (no policy-posture change); drop the legacy-gemini line. Legacy gemini refusal/availability smokes (host-overflow.md:244): unattended-dispatch-smoke.ts (allowedHosts ["gemini"], host "gemini", chk008-gemini*) and dispatch-run-smoke.ts (chk006-gemini refusal path) — convert to antigravity or remove, keeping the dispatch_auto refusal semantics intact. Acceptance: dispatch-policy parse/refusal tests green; no gemini host token remains in policy/dispatch; antigravity recognized exactly once in each filter.

happy.desc: dispatch-policy.ts LEGACY_KNOWN_HOSTS array does not contain gemini; CURRENT_KNOWN_HOSTS contains antigravity exactly once -> confirms gemini retired from host model and antigravity is the sole current entry; WHY: host identity retirement is the core deliverable

dispatch-policy.ts parseHost: input gemini is rejected (throws or returns undefined/error) rather than resolving to any host; input antigravity and agy both resolve to antigravity -> confirms gemini no longer parses as a valid host; WHY: dead host must not silently route

dispatch-policy.ts unsupportedRealHosts filter at ~line 256 (allowedHosts validation) lists antigravity exactly once and does not list gemini; filter at ~line 406 (dispatch_auto policy check) also lists antigravity exactly once and does not list gemini -> confirms promote without duplication; WHY: antigravity was already present so removing gemini without adding antigravity again avoids duplicates

unattended-dispatch-smoke.ts chk008 tests use host:antigravity and allowedHosts:[antigravity] instead of gemini; dispatch_auto still throws matching /not available|not unattended-safe|unattendedSafe=false/ -> confirms legacy gemini smoke converted to antigravity with refusal semantics preserved; WHY: dispatch_auto refusal is a security invariant

antigravity gains the supervised real-leaf dispatch path (runAntigravityRealLeafDispatch or equivalent is reachable from dispatch_run for host=antigravity) -> confirms PROMOTE from scaffolded-only to supervised real-leaf; WHY: the whole point of the migration is that antigravity replaces gemini as the real-leaf host
